meta.title: 摄影常识｜上镜胖十斤，从来不是镜头问题！
meta.title_en: Camera Adds Ten Pounds? It's Not the Lens

scenes.title_en: Opening: The Truth About Looking Fat
scenes.context: 上镜显胖不是因为你本来就胖，更不是因为所谓的镜头畸变和长焦镜头，真正决定胖瘦的是你和镜头之间的物理距离。
sentences: Looking fat isn't the lens's fault.
paraphrase: Looking fat isn't the lens's fault.
scenes.speak: Looking fat isn't the lens's fault. Physical distance decides the look.

scenes.context: 距离的变化产生近大远小的透视关系，会直接重塑鼻子和面部的比例。
scenes.speak: Bigger-near-smaller-far is perspective. Distance reshapes facial proportions.

scenes.context: 保持人和镜头距离不变，分别用35mm和135mm画面拍摄放大，背景的压缩程度根本没变。
sentences: The background compression stays the same.
paraphrase: The background compression stays the same.
scenes.speak: Same distance, different focal lengths. The background compression stays the same.

scenes.context: 压缩从来不属于任何焦段的镜头，它只属于远距离而产生的弱透视，让画面变平。
sentences: It comes from weak perspective at distance.
paraphrase: It comes from weak perspective at distance.
scenes.speak: Compression belongs to no lens. It comes from weak perspective at distance.

scenes.title_cn: 光学放大 vs 数码裁切
scenes.context: 长焦镜头的光学放大无损保留画质，而后期数码裁切会放大噪点损失画质，这就是长焦的本质差异。
sentences: Optical zoom keeps the quality lossless.
paraphrase: Optical zoom keeps the quality lossless.
scenes.speak: Optical zoom keeps the quality lossless. Digital cropping amplifies noise.

scenes.context: 长焦镜头的本质是无损的光学放大镜，推到20米外，人脸上五官的深度也悄然消失。
sentences: A telephoto is a lossless magnifier.
paraphrase: A telephoto is a lossless magnifier.
scenes.speak: A telephoto is a lossless magnifier. Distance flattens facial depth.

scenes.context: 极远的物理距离会抹平正面的纵深，但它抹不掉侧面的轮廓线，所以答案只有三个字：拍侧脸。
sentences: Distance can't erase the profile line.
用侧脸重新切出立体感。
paraphrase: Distance can't erase the profile line.
scenes.speak: Distance can't erase the profile line. Re-carve depth with the profile.

scenes.context: 真正成熟的摄影不是被参数绑架，而是合理利用距离和角度，去驯化光学的性格。
sentences: Don't be held hostage by settings.
用距离和角度驯化光学。
Tame optics with distance and angle.
paraphrase: Don't be held hostage by settings.
Tame optics with distance and angle.
scenes.speak: Don't be held hostage by settings. Tame optics with distance and angle.

practice: Looking fat isn't the lens's fault.
答案只有三个字：拍侧脸。
The answer is three words: shoot the profile.
pitfalls: 理解是距离透视造成的
压缩属于距离而非焦段
